research.cue: Use for a bounded investigation that benefits from dedicated research.

diagnose.cue: Reproduce the reported symptom and establish its supported cause.

delegate.cue: Use when independently owned implementation work benefits from fresh context.

interface-design.cue: Use when accepted work creates or materially reshapes an interface; do not use only to restore an established design.

research.cue: Use for a bounded investigation needed by the implementation.

testing.cue: Develop behavior-changing work test first and preserve focused regression coverage.

documentation.cue: Resolve the implementation's effect on durable project knowledge.

review.cue: Review the validated work against accepted intent and engineering risk.

commit.cue: Commit the completed work as coherent repository outcomes.
